title: Variance and second moment
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $\pi$ be a probability distribution on $\Omega$, and let $f:(\mathrm{Fin}\ n\to\Omega)\to\mathbb R$. Under the product distribution with independent coordinates each distributed according to $\pi$, the variance of $f$ equals its second moment minus the square of its mean.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on $n$ coordinates taking values in $\Omega$
